rule: ADR 0008 — a default visual change needs incumbent/variant evidence and a logged human decision

decisions.incumbent: freeform (ScopeSimulation root force + grid-packed child scopes)
decisions.variant: timeline (?graphLayout=timeline, reachable by hook and permalink)
decisions.effect: A reserved child lane clears the recorded freeform parent/child overlap. The variant still cuts mean edge length by 45%; occupied width falls by 61% and the aspect moves toward a column. No claim about frame time.
decisions.images: pending — recapture incumbent and variant shots before a human decision
decisions.decision: pending human review; Phase 1 flexibility gate items 5-6 also outstanding

decisions.incumbent: freeform (18 scattered cards, turn card plus turn lane, long cross-turn diagonals)
decisions.variant: chapters (?graphLayout=chapters or g): one card per turn, children as internal chips, compact 2-column grid
decisions.data: docs/screenshots/reports/graph-baseline.json — chapters measured from the packed card layout (CHAPTER_CARD 360x200, 1600x900 viewport); all other modes remain solver-position metrics
decisions.effect: Turn-lane and turn-card duplication removed; five packed cards carry the work of the 18 source nodes as internal chips, the grid is compact and overlap-free, and the failure reads inside its turn. No claim about task success or time.
decisions.decision: pending human review; ADR 0008 default gate not closed

decisions.incumbent: dynamic-range (?ui preset; one scale at a time, zoom reveals a different LOD)
decisions.variant: octaves (?graphLayout=octaves) — one hierarchy drawn at 1x, 1/2x and 1/4x world scale
decisions.data: src/layout/octaves.ts + app/pi/src/graph-layout.ts — one position authority, per-node size from opaque octave descriptors
decisions.effect: Three self-similar rings are visible in one frame; zooming promotes each smaller ring to a readable card. No renderer branch or default change. No claim about task success or time.
decisions.images: regenerable pair: docs/screenshots/pi/pi-agent-dynamic-range.png (incumbent), docs/screenshots/pi/pi-agent-octaves.png (variant) via pnpm --filter pi shot octaves,dynamic-range; zoom evidence: docs/screenshots/pi/pi-agent-octaves-near.png
decisions.decision: pending human review; ADR 0008 default gate not closed

decisions.incumbent: octaves (?graphLayout=octaves) — one card colour for every octave
decisions.variant: octaves-palette — same layout with step colouring per octave through the existing data.style seam
decisions.data: app/pi/src/host.ts — OCTAVE_PALETTE applied only when graphLayout=octaves and octavePalette=1
decisions.effect: Root, branches and work cards take three distinct step colours. Positions, sizes, edges and renderer are unchanged. Ported from the scale-lab winner; no claim about task success or time.
decisions.images: regenerable pair: docs/screenshots/pi/pi-agent-octaves.png (incumbent), docs/screenshots/pi/pi-agent-octaves-palette.png (variant) via pnpm --filter pi shot octaves,octaves-palette
decisions.decision: pending human review; ADR 0008 default gate not closed

decisions.data: src/layout/chapters.ts — columns are capped by the opt-in value and the viewport
decisions.effect: A wider canvas fills additional chapter columns without moving the library's default two-column cap. No claim about task success or time.
decisions.images: regenerable pair: docs/screenshots/pi/pi-agent-chapters.png (incumbent), docs/screenshots/pi/pi-agent-chapters-wide.png (variant) via pnpm --filter pi shots:all
decisions.decision: pending human review; ADR 0008 default gate not closed
